title: 100-Mode Grid 14k Endurance Continuation
intuition: Continues a passing 7,000-step `grid100` checkpoint out to 14,000 updates with verified prefix parity, testing whether all 100 modes and tight covariance bounds survive twice the training horizon.
failure_mode: Gradual prototype collapse, mass imbalance drift, or late-horizon minimax instability erodes precision or drops modes.
protocol_notes: Strict continuation of `grid100` (requires passing 7k parent checkpoint and bit-exact prefix parity).
